name: one-claim-with-evidence
description: A founder asks agents to keep a pitch slide focused on one claim with visible support.

judgment.statement: For each pitch slide, lead with one substantive claim, show its supporting evidence, and move detailed methods to the appendix.
judgment.rationale: An audience cannot evaluate a claim hidden among several competing points and unexplained numbers.

limits: Not a universal rule for teaching decks or technical reference slides.
Use only verified metrics and distinguish proposed experiments from results.

evidence.summary: Explicit synthetic guidance; not a measured task outcome.
